## About
American Veteran Construction is a general contractor on W Indian School Rd in Phoenix. Steven and his team take on the everyday jobs that keep a house or rental working: plumbing, electrical, drywall, carpet stretching, washer and dryer installation and kitchen work.
One customer put it simply: it's handy to be able to call one person to do it all. Homeowners and landlords call us when they need a repair done right, without chasing down a different trade for every job.
We're rated 4.7 on Google from 29 reviews. Give us a call on a weekday and tell us what's going on.

## Services
- Plumbing and electrical jobs: Plumbing and electrical repairs around the house, done by the same crew.
- Drywall repair, carpet stretching and washer and dryer installation: The smaller jobs that pile up, like patching drywall, stretching carpet and getting a washer and dryer installed.
- Rental property repairs: Getting a rental fixed up so it's ready for the next tenant.

## FAQ
Q: What hours are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Q: Do you work on rental properties?
A: Yes. A landlord had Steven and his team do repairs on her rental so it was ready before her tenant moved in.

Q: Can you handle more than one kind of job?
A: That's a lot of what we do. One customer said Steven can take on many different tasks, so you don't need a different person for each.
